import pandas as pd
import openpyxl
from datetime import datetime
from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta
import os

# Load the workbook
spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/32468/1_32468_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/32468_0_1ee07f8a/1_32468_output.xlsx"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

# Load the discount data
discount_df = pd.read_excel(spreadsheet_path, sheet_name='DISCOUNT', header=2)
discount_df['Month'] = pd.to_datetime(discount_df['Month'])

# Group by month and sum the totals
discount_monthly = discount_df.groupby('Month')['Total'].sum().reset_index()
print("Monthly discount totals:")
print(discount_monthly.head(20))

# Load the workbook with openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
summary_sheet = wb['SUMMARY']

# For each row from 5 to 35 in the SUMMARY sheet
# Column H (8) contains the month, Column I (9) needs the 12-month discount sum
for row_idx in range(5, 36):  # rows 5 to 35
    month_cell = summary_sheet.cell(row=row_idx, column=8)  # Column H
    
    if month_cell.value and isinstance(month_cell.value, datetime):
        start_month = month_cell.value
        # Calculate end month (11 months after start, so 12 months total including start)
        end_month = start_month + relativedelta(months=11)
        
        # Sum discounts for this 12-month period
        mask = (discount_df['Month'] >= start_month) & (discount_df['Month'] <= end_month)
        total_discount = discount_df[mask]['Total'].sum()
        
        # Write to column I (column 9)
        summary_sheet.cell(row=row_idx, column=9, value=total_discount)
        
        print(f"Row {row_idx}: {start_month.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} to {end_month.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} = {total_discount}")

# Save the workbook

print(f"\nFile saved to {output_path}")
